notes: Units made by recolouring another unit's sprites (recolor.py). Colours are the source art's flat fills; every pixel that's a blend of the outline and one of them gets the same blend of its new colour. A pixel closer to a kept colour (or its blend with the outline) is left alone.

units.name: fire_watcher
units.notes: M6 (docs/plans/city-risks.md, decision Q7): the guard with a red jacket and cap, so a fire watcher stands out from guards. The spear (shaft and head) and the leg wraps are kept. Art of its own waits for the Blender walker experiment.
